title: Repair orbit collection review blockers
objective: Fix Inspector-blocked issues in the orbit collection implementation so it is safe to review and commit.
instructions: Fix the critical path deletion bug: reject setting names '.', '..', hidden/path-like names if needed, and ensure real setting directories stay inside the real output directory with os.path.commonpath before any deletion.

Strengthen JSON validation for orbit specs and light settings: required nested vector/rotator/light keys, bool/string type checks, numeric conversion errors surfaced as ValueError, and math.isfinite checks for numeric values.

Fix generated-output hygiene by either moving defaults/docs under examples/flashlight/tmp/ or adding .gitignore coverage for examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json and examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output*. Keep README consistent with the chosen approach.
Address the ASpotLight spawn rotation risk noted by Inspector: spawn without a rotation and set absolute location/rotation explicitly after mobility setup, matching docs/agents.mcp_usage.md guidance.

Run non-simulator validation: py_compile for the new script, json.tool for the example settings, --help import check, and focused smoke tests proving '.', '..', path-like names, and non-finite numeric values are rejected.
Do not run simulator-dependent commands. Do not perform git operations.

artifacts: Orbit collection render mode must reject light setting names '.' and '..' before prepare_setting_output_dir because they can escape output_dir and trigger shutil.rmtree on parent directories.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with changed files, tests run, and any residual live-sim validation requirements.
definition_of_done: Inspector critical and warning findings are fixed or explicitly justified.
Output path validation prevents deletion outside the intended output directory before shutil.rmtree can run.
README and ignore/default output behavior are consistent.
